featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing — misleading website and no customer support
I have ordered from this store multiple times, and unfortunately, every single time there has been an issue.
One time, they sent my parcel with missing products.
And now again, their website showed the items as “in stock,” but after placing the order, I found out that they were actually not available. They still haven’t updated their website, which is completely misleading for customers.
Since then, I have been continuously chasing them for a refund and for order status updates. They do not pick up calls at all — I tried calling them multiple times a day — and they rarely respond to messages. Whenever they do reply, the information keeps changing every time, and there is no clear update.
This kind of experience is extremely stressful, especially for those of us running small businesses who rely on timely supplies.
Right now, I still do not have any proper update on my refund or my order.
Very unprofessional service.
I do not recommend ordering from this store unless they improve their communication, honesty, and website accuracy.

featured_reviews.name: Divya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Situated in Abdul Rehman Street this place is a bit difficult to find due to it's location. Also, it's located on the first floor.

Honestly, this place is like being in heaven for artists and art lovers alike. It has got all possible brands and all possible things that an artist needs and wants. The only problem that I found is that it is way too expensive.

Situated in Abdul Rehman, you would get the same products at the lowest price possible in nearby shops. No doubt that the brands you get here are quite difficult to find nearby but, if you are not really a brand specific shopper I would suggest you to walk down the street and you will get the exact same product at dirt cheap prices.

Also a thing that was a bit off-putting was the service provided. It felt like the staff was forced to help and showed the least amount of interest.

A Century of Timeless Treasures
Stepping into this century-old antique shop is like stepping back in time. The creaking floorboards and dusty shelves are filled with a treasure trove of history. From vintage furniture to delicate porcelain, every item tells a story.
The shop's knowledgeable staff is always on hand to provide insights into the history and provenance of their pieces. Their passion for antiques is evident in their enthusiasm and expertise.
Whether you're a seasoned collector or simply looking for a unique piece to add to your home, this antique shop is a must-visit. It's a place where you can discover the beauty and charm of the past.
